title: Zane, farashi da siyar da layin saƙa da saƙa

say: Zane, farashi da siyar da layin saƙa da saƙa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module biyar na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.

Skill kadai ba ya biya. A galibin Najeriya yanayi yana da zafi na tsawon shekara, don haka jakunkuna, kayan gida, kayan jarirai, saman sama da kyaututtuka yawanci ana sayar da su a hankali fiye da masu tsalle-tsalle masu nauyi.

say: Wannan tsarin yana nuna muku yadda ake tsara ƙaramin layin samfur, farashi daga bayananku, kuma ku sayar da shi tare da kyawawan hotuna da halayen biyan kuɗi masu aminci.

say: Auduga yana da numfashi kuma yana sha, yana da kyau ga jakunkuna, kayan auduga da kayan jarirai. Haɗe-haɗe na lilin suna da sanyi da ƙwanƙwasa. Viscose yana haɗuwa da labule da kyau don yadin yadin da aka saka da filaye masu gudana.

panel.heading: Daidaita fiber zuwa samfur da yanayi
items: Auduga: jakunkuna, kayan abinci, kayan jarirai
Abubuwan haɗin lilin: saman haske, masu tseren tebur
Viscose blends: yadin da aka saka scarves, gudana saman
Acrylic: kayan wasan yara, jakunkuna, kushin
Wool: harmattan kayan haɗi

say: Acrylic yana da araha kuma mai launi, yana da kyau ga kayan wasan yara da kushiyoyin, amma ba ya numfashi kuma yana narkewa a ƙarƙashin ƙarfe mai zafi. Wool yana da dumi, mafi kyau ga kayan haɗi na harmattan.

say: Ba koyaushe ake yiwa lakabin zaren kasuwa ba. Gwajin ƙonewa yana gaya muku dangin fiber. Snip game da 5 cm, kuma riƙe shi da tweezers na ƙarfe, ba yatsu, a kan kwano na ruwa.
Yi aiki nesa da yadudduka da silinda gas, kada ku kusa da murhu da ake amfani da su, ba da iska a ɗakin, kuma a nisanta yara.

panel.heading: Amintaccen gwajin ƙonawa don zaren da ba a lakafta shi ba
items: Yanke kusan 5 cm na yarn
Rike da tweezers karfe akan ruwa
Kamshin takarda, toka mai laushi mai laushi: fiber shuka
Kamshin gashi, yana fitar da kanta: ulu
Ya narke zuwa dutse mai wuya: roba
panel.rule: Short snip, karfe tweezers, bisa ruwa. Yara tafi.

say: Auduga, lilin da viscose wari kamar takarda mai ƙonewa kuma suna barin toka mai laushi. Wool yana wari kamar kona gashi kuma yana fitar da kansa. Synthetics suna narke cikin katako mai wuya, kuma suna iya digo da ƙone fata.

say: Maimakon yin ɗaya daga cikin komai, zaɓi wasu samfurori a matakai uku. Misali, Tolu a Abeokuta ya shirya tarin tarin bukukuwan aure, bukukuwan suna da kyaututtuka.

panel.heading: Kyakkyawan, mafi kyau, mafi kyau a cikin labarin launi ɗaya
items: Da kyau: saitin teku, kamar awa 1
Mafi kyau: jakar tapestry, kamar 4 hours
Mafi kyau: bargon jariri na al'ada, 15 hours ko fiye
Labari mai launi: cream, mustard, indigo
Katin samfur don kowane abu

say: Kyakkyawar kayanta shine saitin ƙorafi wanda ke ɗaukar kusan awa 1 kuma yana kawo sabbin abokan ciniki a ciki. Mafi kyawun kayanta, babban mai siyarwa, jakar kaset ne. Mafi kyawunta shine bargon jariri na al'ada tare da farkon jariri.

say: Ta yi amfani da labarin launi guda ɗaya, kirim, mustard da indigo, don haka hotunanta suna da kwarewa tare. Kuma ta rubuta katin samfur ga kowane, tare da zaren, ƙugiya, gram, lokaci da girma, don haka jaka na 20 ya dace da na farko.

say: Ayyukan da aka yi da hannu sau da yawa ba su da tsada saboda mai yin ya ƙidaya zaren kawai. Farashin da ya dace ya ƙunshi kayan aiki, lokacinku, rabon kuɗin tafiyarwa, da riba.
Zaren Mercy ya kai kimanin naira 2,500 a kowace g 100 na ball, don haka naira 25 a kowace gram. Gin 180 nata ya kai 4,500, da 500 don tag da marufi.
Lokacinta shine awa 10.5 akan naira 800 awa daya: 8,400.
Ta kara da kashi 10 cikin dari, da kuma kashi 25 cikin dari.
Naira 18,425 kenan, wanda ta kai 18,500 a matsayin farashinta.
Markup riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashi. Mercy ta kara kashi 25 cikin dari.

cards.d: Riba a matsayin kashi na farashi. Ribar da Mercy ta samu 3,685 shine kashi 25% na kudinta.
Riba a matsayin kashi na farashi: 20%. Rangwamen 20% zai shafe duk ribarta.
Kasuwanci yana kiyaye 30%? Raba da 0.7. 18,500 / 0.7 yana nufin farashin kanti na kusan 26,500.

say: Margin riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashin siyarwa. Gefenta yana da kashi 20 cikin 100, don haka rangwamen kashi 20 zai shafe duk wata ribar da ta samu. Koyaushe bincika rangwame akan gefe.

say: A cikin kaya, wani kanti yana biyan ku ne kawai bayan an sayar da abu, kuma yana kiyaye kwamiti. Idan ya kiyaye kashi 30, raba farashin ku da 0.7. Farashin kanti ya kamata ya zama akalla kusan naira 26,500. Yarda da sharuɗɗan a rubuce.

say: Mai siye ba zai iya taɓa zaren ba, don haka dole ne hotonku yayi wannan aikin. Harba kusa da taga a cikin hasken rana, a bayan fage, tare da kashe walƙiya.
Ɗauki saiti: dukan abu, kusa da ɗigon, abin da ake amfani da shi, da kuma ɗaya tare da mai mulki don girman.

say: Ya kamata lissafin ku ya amsa girman, fiber, kulawa, farashi, bayarwa da lokacin jagora, don haka masu siye su daina yin tambayoyi guda biyar iri ɗaya.

say: Faɗakarwar canja wurin karya da hotunan kariyar kwamfuta dabaru ne na gama-gari. Tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin bankin ku ko aikace-aikacen walat ɗinku kafin aikawa, kuma kada ku raba OTP, PIN ko kalmar sirri.
Sa'an nan kuma shirya da kyau, ƙara tag da katin kulawa, kuma aika saƙon godiya.

say: Don tunawa. Zabi auduga da cakuda shuka don yanayin dumi. Ƙona gwajin lafiya, a kan ruwa. Gina tsani mai kyau, mafi kyau, mafi kyau a cikin labarin launi ɗaya. Farashi tare da kayan aiki, aiki, kari da riba. Kuma aika kawai bayan nuna biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku.

say: Yanzu tsara tarin ku kuma tambayi masu siye uku masu yiwuwa abin da za su zaɓa. Yi takardar farashi don samfurori biyu. Sannan ƙaddamar da samfur ɗaya akan layi tare da hotuna huɗu, jeri, tag da rikodin tallace-tallace.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
